en.hook: I tried to grasp twice and failed, then I got it on the third try. The tree remembered where I was. My old ifs forgot.
en.mission: In `code/main.py` change `Retry("retry", 3, ...)` to `Retry("retry", 2, ...)` and run it. Predict which tick the task fails on and what the root returns.

ko.mission: `code/main.py`에서 `Retry("retry", 3, ...)`을 `Retry("retry", 2, ...)`로 바꿔 실행하세요. 작업이 몇 번째 tick에 실패하고 root가 무엇을 돌려줄지 예측하세요.
